result.title: Training-Free Anonymization of Driving Data with Promptable Segmentation and 3D Human Mesh Recovery
result.summary: Camera recordings for autonomous driving contain faces and license plates that should be anonymized before labeling, sharing, or training. Dedicated detectors can miss small plates and faces behind vehicle glass. We present FM-Anonymize, a training-free anonymization pipeline that combines promptable segmentation, 3D human mesh recovery, and generative replacement. SAM 3 locates people, faces, and vehicles and searches zoomed vehicle crops for plates, occupants, and windows. SAM 3D Body assesses face visibility from head orientation and projects head regions for blurring. Optional diffusion inpainting replaces eligible blurred heads with synthetic faces, guided by estimated pose and keypoints. On PP4AV, the blur pipeline protects 97.8% of faces and 95.5% of plates, the highest privacy recall of all compared methods at their default settings. On our recordings, where the localization thresholds were set, it protects 97.1% of faces and 93.4% of plates, compared with 93.7%/73.0% for UrbanAnonymizer, 42.7%/40.7% for EgoBlur, and 96.6% of faces for deface. Synthetic replacement raises full-body keypoint average precision over blurring from 54.1% to 79.6% on our recordings and from 39.9% to 68.3% on PP4AV. Code and configurations are available on https://github.com/max-a-ai/FM-Anonymize

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出免训练的 FM-Anonymize 流水线，用 SAM 3 定位人、脸、车牌与车窗，用 SAM 3D Body 依头部朝向判断人脸可见性并投影区域做模糊，可选扩散修复以合成人脸替换，从而在自动驾驶数据上提升隐私召回并保留下游关键点检测性能。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于驾驶数据隐私脱敏的应用工程，虽用到分割与 3D 人体网格恢复，但不涉及 latent 推理状态、证据筛选或停止决策等机制，与 LVR 主线无可核查的具体借鉴线索。
